scope: Independent read of the already completed actual R2 full-GET receipt plus complete local payload and fixed local Git-blob comparisons. This verifier made no network request, second remote GET, credential read, source modification, acceptance or parent acknowledgement.

metadata_qualification.explanation: Uploader planning and payload manifest record the pre-commit snapshot base a78372d. They were not rewritten. All 283 actual public payload files were independently compared byte-for-byte to the subsequently created and pushed fixed core commit f2901de.

remote_get_evidence_boundary.meaning: The original uploader records expected SHA256 plus full_get_sha256_verified, GET HTTP200 and observed readback byte count, rather than a redundant separate observed-GET digest. The matching uploader source verifies streamed full-GET length and SHA256 against expected before returning that marker. This independent verifier rehashes actual local payload and checks every recorded marker; it does not observe another remote response.
